svg.title: vue-clamp lineclamp entrypoint benchmark matrix
svg.desc: LineClamp root and Pretext entrypoint matrix with active time and target deltas.
svg.text: Only the shared root/Pretext public contract is shown. N/A means a target does not implement the scenario.
Green is lower cost, red is higher cost. The first panel shows active ms; the second shows root-to-Pretext deltas.
Timing applies to synchronous component work under the CSS-controlled predictive contract; see Markdown comparability notes.
~ and a top-right triangle mark low-confidence deltas; high CV, overlapping mean MOE, or median/mean direction mismatch is the trigger.
Cell text is median active ms; color is delta vs this scenario's first supported target.
